name: Cheesy Potato Bake
summary: Sliced potatoes baked in a cheddar milk sauce. Mostly oven time.

ingredients.name: russet potatoes, thinly sliced (no need to peel)

instructions: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Grease a 9×13-inch baking dish.
Melt the butter in a pot over medium heat. Stir in the flour and cook 1 minute. Whisk in the milk a little at a time, then simmer 3–4 minutes, stirring, until it thickens slightly.
Take the pot off the heat. Stir in half the cheddar, the garlic powder, 1 tsp salt, and pepper.
Layer the potatoes and onion in the dish and pour the sauce over them. Press down so the potatoes are mostly covered. Top with the rest of the cheese.
Cover with foil and bake 45 minutes. Uncover and bake another 25–30 minutes, until a knife slides through easily and the top is brown.

substitutions.substitute: 1.5 tbsp cornstarch whisked into the cold milk before heating

glutenFree.notes: Everything else (potatoes, milk, cheddar, butter) is naturally gluten-free.

budgetNotes: Russets from the 10 lb bag are the cheapest calories on this site, at about $0.66/kg.
Slice the potatoes thin and even (about 3 mm). A cheap mandoline helps but a knife is fine.
Leftovers reheat well. You can also fry squares of it in a pan the next morning and add an egg.

pricingMetadata.notes: Russet potatoes $2.99/10 lb bag ($0.66/kg). Onion $1.07 each. Butter $1.36/100 g (No Name). Flour $0.10/100 g. Milk $2.74/L (Sealtest 2 L, $5.48). Cheddar $1.43/100 g (site estimate). Spices estimated.
